## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CME update (Juno, Mars, OSIRIS-APEX, Parker Solar Probe, Solar Orbiter, Juno)
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-06-12T16:00:23Z
## Message ID: 20240612-AL-006
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

Update on CME with ID 2024-06-11T23:12:00-CME-001 (see previous notification 20240612-AL-005).  Based on preliminary analysis by the Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office and heliospheric modeling carried out at NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, it is estimated that the CME may impact Mars, OSIRIS-APEX, Parker Solar Probe, Solar Orbiter, and Juno (glancing blow). The leading edge of the CME will reach Mars at 2024-06-15T00:59Z, OSIRIS-APEX at 2024-06-13T17:55Z, Parker Solar Probe at 2024-06-12T21:56Z and Solar Orbiter at 2024-06-14T01:35Z (plus minus 7 hours). The flank of the CME may reach Juno at 2024-06-26T06:00Z (plus minus 7 hours). 


CME parameters are (O-type):

Start time of the event: 2024-06-11T23:12Z.

Estimated speed: ~1312 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 48 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 113/26 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-11T23:12:00-CME-001

## Notes: 

This CME event (2024-06-11T23:12:00-CME-001) is associated with SEP at STEREO A with ID 2024-06-12T00:21:00-SEP-001 (see notifications 20240612-AL-001, 20240612-AL-002), and SEP at SOHO with ID 2024-06-12T02:58:00-SEP-001 (see notification 20240612-AL-004).

SCORE CME typification system:
S-type: CMEs with speeds less than 500 km/s
C-type: Common 500-999 km/s
O-type: Occasional 1000-1999 km/s
R-type: Rare 2000-2999 km/s
ER-type: Extremely Rare >3000 km/s
